example_en: That is certainly an interesting question.

example_en: Mothers have a lot of strength; however, they can’t do everything on their own.

example_en: It is cold, but I’m nevertheless riding my bike.

example_en: Janosch is ill and therefore stays at home in bed today.

example_en: Luisa likes the suggestion, her sister in turn is against it.

example_en: She only likes classical music, Jonathan, on the other hand, likes listening to everything.

example_en: On the one hand I would like to travel, but on the other hand I should save money.

example_en: There are therefore only two possibilities.

example_en: The shirt is not blue, but rather gray.

example_en: The more Timo eats, the bigger he gets.

example_en: On the one hand I’m happy that you’re moving to Berlin, on the other hand I’m also sad that you’re leaving.

example_de: Nina wollte nach Spanien reisen, aber fährt stattdessen nach Frankreich.
example_en: Nina wanted to travel to Spain, but is going to France instead.

definition: as far as that goes, insofar, therefore

example_en: I didn’t expect to finish second, and therefore I am more than satisfied.

example_en: As far as I know, the seminar isn’t taking place today.

example_en: Tea, coffee, etc. are popular products that Germany buys from other countries.

example_en: She took a medication, and as a result she got worse.

example_en: Today’s soccer match is England versus Germany.

example_en: Tommy likes extra spicy food.

example_en: She works and takes care of her old parents on the side.
